FROM ins_tra_funds where consider_type = '2' AND STATUS = '3' AND prac_trade_amount IS NOT NULL AND DELFLAG_ = '1'
AND CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.year}
AND (CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.begin} or CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.center} or CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.end})

select ifnull (sum(ifnull(contract_amount,0)),0) from ins_tra_funds where investment_type = '04' and delflag_ = '1' and status = '6' and financial_Asssts_Num = #{financialAssstsNum}

SELECT b.relName relName, b.relNumber relNumber, b.relType relType, sum(b.relTradeAmount) relTradeAmount FROM (SELECT SUM (COALESCE(rel_trade_amount, 0)) relTradeAmount, rel_name relName, rel_number relNumber, REL_TYPE relType FROM ins_tra_funds WHERE delflag_ = '1' AND major_trade = '0' AND is_accumulated = '0' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND data_version = 'E2.0' AND tran_date BETWEEN #{ startTime } AND #{ endTime } GROUP BY rel_name, rel_number, REL_TYPE UNION ALL SELECT SUM (COALESCE(rel_trade_amount, 0)) relTradeAmount, rel_name relName, rel_number relNumber, REL_TYPE relType FROM ins_tra_service WHERE delflag_ = '1' AND is_agreement = '0' AND major_trade = '0' and is_accumulated = '0' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND data_version = 'E2.0' AND contract_date BETWEEN #{ startTime } AND #{ endTime } GROUP BY rel_name, rel_number, REL_TYPE UNION ALL SELECT SUM (COALESCE(rel_trade_amount, 0)) relTradeAmount, rel_name relName, rel_number relNumber, REL_TYPE relType FROM ins_tra_business WHERE delflag_ = '1' AND is_agreement = '0' AND major_trade = '0' AND is_accumulated = '0' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND data_version = 'E2.0' AND contract_date BETWEEN #{ startTime } AND #{ endTime } GROUP BY rel_name, rel_number, REL_TYPE UNION ALL SELECT SUM (COALESCE(rel_trade_amount, 0)) relTradeAmount, rel_name relName, rel_number relNumber, REL_TYPE relType FROM ins_tra_interest WHERE delflag_ = '1' AND major_trade = '0' AND is_accumulated = '0' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND data_version = 'E2.0' AND contract_date BETWEEN #{ startTime } AND #{ endTime } GROUP BY rel_name, rel_number, REL_TYPE) b GROUP BY b.relName, b.relNumber, b.relType
